title: Moress
description: This mod adds new blocks and item for building, role play and survival.
body:
This mod adds blocks and items for construction and survival.
Version 0.a.0.a has just been released.
Currently, the mod adds (list subject to change):
- Asphalt,
- Asphalt with line:
  - Straight,
  - Bold Straight,
  - To side,
  - Bold To side,
  - To side and straight,
  - Bold To side and straight,
  - To sideway and straight,
  - Bold To sideway and straight.

As well as inventory tabs (list subject to change):
- Moress: City

This mod will be updated until my hands give out :)
